text.en: Switch between task results, batch canvas and individual image workflows with shared tabs and breadcrumbs. A reorganized task header groups filters, progress and actions, including when inspecting archived collections.
text.zh-CN: 任务结果、批次画布与单图流程通过统一标签和面包屑衔接；任务头部重排需求、筛选、进度和操作，归档素材集也可查看历史工作流。
